lines.text: The desert will blossom like a rose, and the glory of Lebanon will be given to it.
Limp hands and feeble knees are to be strengthened, and anxious hearts are told not to fear.
Blind eyes will be opened, the lame will leap like a lion, and waters will gush in the wilderness.
Where jackals once lay, cedars will grow, and a highway called the Way of Holiness appears.
The redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy.
